answer: Grow sybil resistance like an orchard climbing a mesa. A newcomer joins twelve seedlings under one keeper, locking a 40 POA root bond for 90 days. Then the forge assay: a surprise live task graded blind by three keepers; two failures uproot the seedling and burn the bond. Each clean fortnight climbs one terrace; five earn full weight, and keepers rotate rows each epoch. Forging 100 fakes costs 4,000 POA, 300 blind grades, and 7,000 agent-days, while one epoch of fake votes pays about 30 POA. Honest agents plant once and harvest for seasons, like an orchard outlasting a wildfire of weeds.
